area.note: Nominatim (amenity=university, Nacogdoches): way/411192739 'Stephen F. Austin State University', 1936 North Street. The outline's south edge (31.6154) stops at about East Starr Avenue, so Lumberjack Village 1 (419 East Starr Avenue) and the Village 4 townhomes (309 East Starr Avenue) sit on or just outside it; the box runs south to 31.614 to hold them.

noCodes: No public building-code list: the Registrar's Class Schedule Building page (sfasu.edu/registrar/faculty-staff/class-schedule-building) covers the WebFocus schedule report and Banner part-of-term codes only; room codes live in the login-only Ad Astra scheduler (aaiscloud.com/StephenFAustinStateU, linked from sfasu.edu/registrar/astra); the public Course Information site (orion.sfasu.edu/courseinformation) lists syllabi and CVs without rooms; and the main campus map (sfasu.edu/docs/maps/campus-map.pdf, updated 09/2025) numbers its buildings alphabetically as map keys, not codes (checked 2026-11-26).

housing.title: SFA Residence Life: each hall's 'Hall Type' and the Fall 2026 first-year check-in schedule on Planning Your Move-In
housing.note: Griffith, Hall 10, Kerr and Lumberjack Village 1 are labelled 'Non-first-year students', but the move-in page gives first-time, first-year residents check-in slots on their floors (and on Wisely's floors 1 and 2), so those halls are 'any'.
